title: Tensor compatibility of inverse pullback reduction
statement: Fix D,C,E,H,hl,o,z and the direct-operation coordinates of [def-sf-integral-proper-projection-coordinates]. For a proper morphism f:X→Y between finite-type k-schemes and constructible integral M,N on Y, inverse pullComparison respects the tensor/pullback maps: system pullback of tensor reduction, then the prescribed system pullback/tensor map, then tensor of the two inverse pullComparison components, equals inverse pullComparison on the integral tensor, followed by reduction of the datum pullback/tensor map, followed by tensor reduction on the pulled inputs. This statement contains no projection map, no direct-image counit, and no compact-support comparison.

proof.text: Expand the canonical completed comparison and its specified pullback/tensor model isomorphisms. Naturality of the actual reconstruction counit moves it across reduction of each mapped arrow. Cancel the tensor model with its inverse, then combine the two system-tensor slot maps by bifunctoriality. The pullback model and the two invertible counits cancel in those slots. This gives the forward canonical reduction square. This is the categorical counit computation implemented as the private reduction_comparison and integralComparison_reduction helpers; no finite evaluation or residue Tor argument is needed here.

theorem integralProperTensorPullbackReduction
    {D : FiniteFieldDatum.{u}} {C : D.CoefficientDatum}
    {E : Type u} [Field E] [Algebra (Padic C.l) E]
    [FiniteDimensional (Padic C.l) E]
    (H : SixFunctorHigherOperations D C E) (hl : IsUnit (C.l : D.k))
    (o : Operations C.l E) (z : Realizations C.l E D o)
    {X Y : SixFunctorSpace D} (f : X ⟶ Y) [IsProper f.hom.left]
    (M N : sfIntegralConstructibleCategory C.l E Y.obj.left) :
    (pull C.l E f.hom.left).map (((tensor H hl Y).app M).app N) ≫
        (((Functor.curry.mapIso (pullbackTensorSystemComparison C.l E f.hom.left) ≪≫
          Functor.curryObjProdComp (pull C.l E f.hom.left) (pull C.l E f.hom.left)
            (calculus C.l E X.obj.left).systemClosed.tensor).hom.app
              ((reduce Y).obj M)).app ((reduce Y).obj N)) ≫
        ((Functor.curryObj (calculus C.l E X.obj.left).systemClosed.tensor).map
          ((pullComparison H hl o z f).inv.app M)).app _ ≫
        ((Functor.curryObj (calculus C.l E X.obj.left).systemClosed.tensor).obj _).map
          ((pullComparison H hl o z f).inv.app N) =
      (pullComparison H hl o z f).inv.app (((H.integralTensor Y).obj M).obj N) ≫
        (reduce X).map (((pullTensor H f).hom.app M).app N) ≫
        ((tensor H hl X).app ((H.integral.pull f).obj M)).app
          ((H.integral.pull f).obj N)
